title: Alan Turing
summary: Alan Turing was a British mathematician and codebreaker whose work laid foundations for computer science and wartime cryptanalysis.

quiz.question: What code did Turing help break at Bletchley Park?
quiz.explanation: Turing led work on Bombe machines to break Enigma traffic.

quiz.question: Which theoretical model is named after Turing?
quiz.explanation: He proposed the universal Turing machine to formalize computation.

quiz.question: Where did Turing study for his PhD?
quiz.explanation: Turing earned his PhD under Alonzo Church at Princeton University.

quiz.question: What test did Turing propose to evaluate machine intelligence?
quiz.explanation: The 1950 paper described an imitation game now called the Turing test.

quiz.question: What chemical treatment was imposed on Turing after his conviction?
quiz.explanation: He accepted hormone treatment instead of prison after a 1952 conviction.
